decisions: Default track 32×18px/thumb 16px and small track 24×14px/thumb 12px retain the native semantic sizes. Thumb travel derives from track minus thumb minus two 1px insets, including RTL. An explicit optional caller field owns label arrangement. Native checked/disabled/focus states remain independent from label content; no imported fixed specimen position or synthetic value event is used.

Semantic token scalar values are meaningful reusable metrics, never coordinate-keyed specimen dimensions. Widths in native specimen grids remain evidence unless explicitly adopted as a domain layout constraint.
